identity: file hash + source sheet/row when available + role + complete available private context and CI fields; ephemeral DB IDs and motive excluded; ambiguous duplicate contexts fail closed
sealing_gate: all12 valid a3/a123 sources with matching frozen input/code/model; warmups prohibited; all sealed members preflighted against changed material before writing
decisions: Explicit real reviewer CSV only; package hash, opaque IDs, reviewer/timezone timestamp after seal, blindness attestation, and justified rejection/no-candidate/exclusion validated. No automatic human labels.
top1: per configuration, repetitions/cache do not multiply independent decisions; N=0 null/N-D; coverage and exclusions retained; changing ranking across replicas blocks aggregation
known_context_limit: Warmup a3 schema has loader cases with only name+suggestions, no CI/raw_line/source row. Marked explicitly; no first-name-match reconstruction, no claim of source-row identity. Reviewer may declare insufficient_information with reason, retained in coverage and excluded from valid top1 denominator.
